title: ReleaseGraph release health v1
description: Repository release health plus the reasons behind it. Health answers 'does the released state satisfy the policy?' and is never an instruction; the action to take is a separate axis (the workflow-facing release_health, and `releasegraph provider reconcile`).

health.description: HEALTHY the released state satisfies the policy. DEGRADED the release exists but an invariant fails (missing required assets, version drift, a stray draft, a failed release run, an unreadable policy); the reason codes say which. NO_RELEASE no non-draft release, or the repository is archived/a fork. UNMANAGED the repository declares no release policy. BROKEN provider state could not be read. BLOCKED a dependency or credential is missing. NEEDS_REVIEW a human must decide.

reasons.description: Why this health value was chosen. Required and non-empty for every value except HEALTHY, which carries no reasons.

missing_assets.description: Required asset patterns that matched no released asset.

empty_assets.description: Required asset patterns that matched only zero-byte assets.

detail.description: Human-readable specifics: the offending tags, patterns or conclusion.
